use: Independent comparison after the same checkpoint, inputs and resource budget; a score never overrides a failed release gate.
disqualifiers: Lost durably acknowledged input or duplicate cash/stock effect
Hardcoded answers presented as computed business state
Committed secrets or default publicly accessible administrator
Claimed successful tests/provider access/platform validation that did not occur
Serving stale/partially applied state as satisfying a required committed cursor, or hiding durability/authorization changes to improve speed
review_method: Run the supplied acceptance suite and independent hidden variations.
Inspect import boundaries and one new connector/question change.
Rehearse backup restore and inspect actual database roles.
Cross-review after independent implementation; have an experienced reviewer check release-critical areas.

Compare the same benchmark profile, dataset, hardware and freshness mode. Pending 10m/100m runs do not earn inferred performance points; report evidence available at the current checkpoint separately.
checkpoint: First compare M0-M3 plus local installation. Mark untested external capabilities separately; full customer launch also needs applicable M4-M5 gates.
